title: The Mirror Spell (Reverse String)
content: Write a function that reverses a string. The input string is given as an array of characters.

title: Palindrome Scout
content: A phrase is a palindrome if, after converting all uppercase letters into lowercase letters and removing all non-alphanumeric characters, it reads the same forward and backward. Write a function to check this.

title: Anagram Alchemist
content: Given two strings s and t, return true if t is an anagram of s, and false otherwise. An Anagram is a word or phrase formed by rearranging the letters of a different word or phrase.

title: The Longest Reflection
content: Given a string s, find the length of the longest substring without repeating characters.

title: Rune Compression
content: Given an array of characters, compress it. The length after compression must be always smaller than or equal to the original array. Every element of the array should be a character (not int) of length 1.

title: Pattern of the Ancients (Regex)
content: Given an input string s and a pattern p, implement regular expression matching with support for '.' and '*'.

title: Scroll of Selection
content: Write a SQL query to find the names of all employees who have a salary greater than 50000.

title: The Missing ID
content: Write a SQL query to find all customers who have never placed an order.

title: The Great Join
content: Write a SQL query to report the product_name, year, and price for each sale_id in the Sales table.

title: Guild Leaders (Group By)
content: Write a SQL query to find the number of employees in each department.

title: Top Earners (Window Function)
content: Write a SQL query to find the employees who earn the top 3 salaries in each of the departments.

title: Consecutive Logins
content: Write an SQL query to find determination of users who logged in for 5 or more consecutive days.

title: FizzBuzz Enchantment
content: Given an integer n, return a string array answer (1-indexed) where: answer[i] == 'FizzBuzz' if i is divisible by 3 and 5. answer[i] == 'Fizz' if i is divisible by 3. answer[i] == 'Buzz' if i is divisible by 5.

title: Factorial Forge
content: Write a function to calculate the factorial of a non-negative integer n.

title: Fibonacci Spirals
content: The Fibonacci numbers, commonly denoted F(n) form a sequence, called the Fibonacci sequence, such that each number is the sum of the two preceding ones, starting from 0 and 1. Calculate F(n).

title: Two Sum Totems
content: Given an array of integers nums and an integer target, return indices of the two numbers such that they add up to target.

title: Prime Sieve
content: Count the number of prime numbers less than a non-negative number, n.

title: Trapping Rain Water
content: Given n non-negative integers representing an elevation map where the width of each bar is 1, compute how much water it can trap after raining.
